facts.claim: Trade with Europe is mainly conducted through Bombay, which has the finest harbour in India, while Sind and Punjab produce is exported from Karachi.
facts.quote: Since then the trade with Europe has naturally been drawn to Bombay, which has the finest harbour in India, while the produce of Sind and the Punjab is exported from Karachi.

facts.claim: The opening of the Suez Canal and abandonment of the Cape route benefited Bombay and Karachi.
facts.quote: Both have benefited largely by the opening of the Suez Canal and the consequent abandonment of the Cape route (1869).

facts.claim: Bombay City, Karachi, and Aden have Chambers of Commerce and Port Trusts, and Bombay and Ahmadabad have influential associations of native piece-goods merchants.
facts.quote: Bombay City, Karachi, and Aden have Chambers of Commerce and Port Trusts, and Bombay and Ahmadabad have influential associations of native piece- goods merchants.
